    "What is your relationship with mathematics?": "Mathematics has always felt like a distant subject to me. While I loved biology and philosophy, math seemed cold and rigid.     "Do you ever get anxious when thinking about mathematics?": "Yes, absolutely. The moment I see complex equations, my mind goes blank.
